Arboreal_Brachiating_Frame.description: A highly specialized skeletal structure featuring an incredibly mobile shoulder joint (ball-and-socket) and a wide, shallow ribcage. Designed specifically for brachiation: swinging from branch to branch using only the forelimbs.

Semi_Erect_Hominid_Core.description: An upright, bipedal frame featuring a distinctly curved (S-shaped) spine to absorb the shock of permanent two-legged walking. It frees the forelimbs entirely from locomotion duties, fundamentally revolutionizing tool use.
